jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At AutoScout24 , our Data Platform Engineering team builds and operates the AWS-based platform that enables teams across the company to work with data independently. Built around Data Mesh principles, it provides the infrastructure, self-service tooling, and governance that allow domain teams to own and manage their data products.     As Engineering Manager , you ll lead the team responsible for developing and operating this platform. The role combines people leadership with strong technical involvement, from architecture and complex engineering problems to reliability, performance, and cost optimization.   We re also making AI a native part of how our Data Engineering organization works and how people use our platform. This includes bringing AI directly into the daily workflows of Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, as well as making the platform more intelligent, easier to use, and more accessible to business users.     What you ll do Build a team that takes ownership, makes sound technical decisions, and delivers independently. Evolve our AWS-based data platform, making decisions around architecture, reliability, performance, security, and cost. Work alongside engineers on complex technical problems, including hands-on implementation when needed. Develop and improve self-service capabilities for data pipelines, dataset discovery, access management, and data quality monitoring. Strengthen our Data Mesh implementation, including domain ownership, data contracts, access controls, and federated governance. Improve data quality, lineage, and observability through automation and platform-level controls. Work closely with Product, Analytics Engineering, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to understand problems and develop solutions. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom
jobs.description: Software Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom     Location: Remote (UK) Type of contract: Freelance Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time) About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The Role Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting software engineers and developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a software engineer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts.  Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal. The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can. What you’ll be doing Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part What you’ll bring Residence in the UK Fluent English A device with a working microphone No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population. Why join this project? This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. jobs.title: AI Ops Engineer (Business Operations)
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY. The Role We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code. jobs.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. jobs.description: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week Team: Product Start date: ASAP About Neural Concept Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time. About the role Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line. We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself. As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives. You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production. Bij NX Filtration krijg je de kans om onze huidige Risico-Inventarisatie & Evaluatie (RI&E) kritisch onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken in hoeverre deze nog aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk. Onze organisatie, werkzaamheden en processen zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat ook arbeidsrisico's kunnen veranderen. Tijdens deze stage voer jij daarom een onafhankelijke review uit van de bestaande RI&E en het bijbehorende Plan van Aanpak. Je blijft daarbij niet achter je bureau zitten. Je gaat de werkvloer op, voert veiligheidsrondes uit, spreekt met medewerkers en leidinggevenden en analyseert onder andere incidenten, near misses, hazard reports, werkplekinspecties en andere beschikbare veiligheidsinformatie. Je onderzoekt verschillende werkomgevingen binnen NX Filtration, waaronder productie, logistiek, maintenance & facilities, laboratorium/QC en kantoor. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw stage is: “In hoeverre sluit de huidige RI&E van NX Filtration aan op de actuele risico's binnen de organisatie en welke verbetermaatregelen hebben de hoogste prioriteit?” Wie zijn wij NX Filtration produceert membraanfilters die wereldwijd worden gebruikt om de kleinste vervuilingen uit water te filteren. Denk hierbij aan vervuilingen zoals nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Dit heeft geresulteerd in nieuwe en eenvoudige processen voor de behandeling van water, het hergebruik van afvalwater en de productie van drinkwater. Het motto van NX Filtration is “schoon en betaalbaar water voor iedereen”. In 2024 is een geheel nieuwe, zeer moderne fabriek in Hengelo in gebruik genomen. Wat vragen we van jou? Je volgt een relevante HBO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld: Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, of een vergelijkbare technische of veiligheidskundige ople

Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige woningbouwprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid. Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke woningbouwontwikkelingen en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling. Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. · Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie; · Je

Dit ga je doen bij Movares Verdiep je in de theorie over vermoeiing en stabiliteit van stalen bruggen. Onderzoek een technisch vraagstuk dat je samen met je begeleider afstemt. Bedenk en vergelijk oplossingen voor het gekozen vraagstuk. Werk je aanpak, berekeningen, resultaten en conclusies uit in een helder verslag. Draag met jouw onderzoek bij aan het verbreden van de kennis binnen de afdeling. Veel stalen bruggen uit de jaren 60 en 70 zijn toe aan renovatie of vervanging. Daarbij zijn vermoeiing en stabiliteit belangrijke technische thema’s. Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je één van deze onderwerpen. De precieze opdracht stemmen we samen af. Zo verdiep je jouw technische kennis en lever je kennis op die het team kan gebruiken bij complexe bruggen en constructies. Dit ben jij bij Movares Voor deze vacature breng jij mee: Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding Civiele Techniek. Je onderzoekt technische vraagstukken zorgvuldig en onderbouwt je keuzes. Je denkt in oplossingen en vergelijkt verschillende mogelijkheden. Je legt je aanpak, resultaten en conclusies duidelijk en gestructureerd vast. Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren. jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor een onafhankelijke organisatie in het publieke domein op zoek naar een Secretaris van de Adviesraad. De organisatie fungeert als onafhankelijk adviesplatform en kennismotor voor cultuurbeleid binnen een grote gemeente. De secretaris vervult een centrale rol in de ondersteuning van de adviesraad en opereert op het snijvlak van strategie, bestuur en beleid. Monitoren van politieke en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen en vertalen naar strategische advieskansen. Zorgen voor kwalitatief hoogwaardige, bestuurlijk bruikbare adviesnota’s. Analyseren en samenbrengen van input van verschillende stakeholders, onderzoeken en beleidsinformatie. jobs.title: Interim Teamleider en Veranderleider P&O - Veiligheidsregio Kennemerland
jobs.description: Omschrijving Veiligheidsregio Kennemerland (VRK) zet zich met ongeveer 1.400 medewerkers in voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van negen gemeenten. Onder de VRK vallen onder meer de Brandweer, de GGD, Ambulancezorg, Veilig Thuis, Crisisbeheersing en de Meldkamer Noord-Holland. De afdeling P&O is onderdeel van het Facilitair Bedrijf en telt ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Na ruim tien jaar als zelforganiserend team heeft de VRK gekozen voor een nieuwe organisatiestructuur, waarin een groot deel van P&O wordt aangestuurd door een teamleider. Voor deze overgang zoekt de VRK een ervaren interim teamleider en veranderleider die structuur, rust en richting brengt. Je geeft leiding aan 19 medewerkers, onder wie P&O-adviseurs, P&O-medewerkers, recruitment, een procesadviseur en een functioneel beheerder. Je werkt nauw samen met de manager Facilitair Bedrijf, onder wie de beleidsadviseurs en senior P&O-adviseurs vallen. Samen bouwen jullie aan een P&O-afdeling die betrouwbaar levert en door het management wordt gezien als professionele, tactisch-strategische partner. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Leidinggeven aan het team, inclusief eerstelijns personele zorg, teamontwikkeling, prioritering, capaciteit, kwaliteit en resultaten Adviseren over de structurele inrichting en toekomstige aansturing van P&O, resulterend in een advies dat door de relevante stakeholders wordt gedragen Rollen, verantwoordelijkheden, mandaten en besluitvorming binnen P&O verder inrichten en verduidelijken Sturen op gedrag, samenwerking, resultaat en aanspreekbaarheid, met behoud van professionele ruimte Samen met de manager Facilitair Bedrijf de samenhang versterken tussen beleid, senior advies en de overige P&O-disciplines De verbinding tussen P&O en het management versterken Een afdelingsjaarplanning opstellen die richting geeft aan prioriteiten en samenwerking Tactische regie voeren op AFAS en werkprocessen verbeteren en uniformeren Wat vragen wij? Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen. Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads. Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort. Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance. Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself. Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads. Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments. jobs.title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: What is Anori Tech doing? The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work. As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development. We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry. We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years. Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market. Our Motivation At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg. About the Role A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers. Start date : from January 1, 2027 What You'll

jobs.title: Rekrutmen Private Banking Relationship Manager Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI)
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Priority Banking

jobs.description: La mission de Finary Notre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun. Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. jobs.title: MTS: Behavioral Research Scientist
jobs.description: Type: Full Time, Hybrid Team: Research Focus: Applied Research Who We Are We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era. Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here - we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition. Who We Are Not We are not remote. We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings. We are not your typical team. It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special. We are not another “polished” SF startup . We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful. What You’ll Own & Build Model human differences . Turn motivation, goals, personality, identity, experience and technical fluency into psychologically grounded, computationally useful models that guide agents and generalise across users. Infer users’ internal states. Use clickstreams, navigation paths and dwell time to model intent, confusion, patience, confidence and engagement, linking these states to each agent’s persona. Aus hunderten Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstandskunden wissen wir, wie man Software baut, die im Ernstfall trägt. Dort baust du KI-Lösungen in bestehende Fachanwendungen ein. Projektsprache ist Deutsch. Der Alltag läuft remote-first, Kundentermine meist in Frankfurt am Main. jobs.title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
jobs.description: Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen. Warum diese Rolle? Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält. • Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft. • Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten. • Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben • Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung. • Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein. • Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben. • Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen. • Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen. • Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt. Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt. Das bringen Sie mit • Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium • Mehrere Jahre SAP-E

We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. The team NiCE Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where NiCE explores what s next in AI for customer experience. This role is on AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and validates new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster.   We re a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside NiCE Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then decide: kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced Cognigy Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside.   We hire for product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence.   So, what’s the role all about? You ll work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi. Un écosystème innovant pour tous les besoins Joivy est l’alliance stratégique de pionniers tels que DoveVivo, Altido, Chez-Nestor et Open . Ensemble, nous redéfinissons les codes du marché : Pour nos résidents : Une offre flexible (colocations, studios, villas) pour des séjours de toutes durées, portée par une expérience numérique fluide. L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés : Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans). Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe experte et bienveillante, dans un contexte de structuration et de montée en puissance de notre nouveau pôle Quality and Process. Missions : Pilotage au quotidien : planifier l'ensemble des prestations dans le CRM pour garantir une couverture parfaite du parc. Logistique terrain : organiser les tournées des prestataires (clés et accès) en présentiel à Paris et à distance pour les autres régions. Contrôle qualité : veiller à l'excellence des prestations réalisées et résoudre rapidement les imprévus du terrain. Management & optim

jobs.description: Ben jij een HR-student die niet alleen wil meekijken, maar echt wil meewerken? Bij Quatra krijg je geen stage met alleen opdrachten en meekijken vanaf de zijlijn. Je draait mee in het team, krijgt verantwoordelijkheid en leert hoe HR er in de praktijk aan toegaat. Wat ga je doen Als HR-stagiair bij Quatra werk je mee aan alles wat met mensen te maken heeft. Praktisch, operationeel en dichtbij de business. Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar schakelt veel met collega’s en ziet direct wat jouw werk oplevert. Je komt terecht in een klein en betrokken HR-team. We werken informeel, helpen elkaar en zeggen waar het op staat. Geen hiërarchiegedoe, wel korte lijnen. Bij Quatra werken we volgens onze kernwaarden: Connect, Commit, Create. Dat merk je in hoe we samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ondersteunen bij werving en selectie, onboarding en offboarding; Opstellen van arbeidsovereenkomsten en verwerken van personeelsmutaties; Bijhouden van tijd-, verlof- en verzuimadministratie; Meewerken aan lopende HR-projecten en verbeteringen in onze processen; Uitvoeren van je stageopdrachten, afgestemd op jouw opleiding en leerdoelen. Wat breng jij mee? Je volgt een HRM-opleiding (HBO of MBO) of een vergelijkbare opleiding; Je bent enthousiast, gedreven en digitaal handig; Je wilt leren door te doen en durft vragen te stellen; Je werkt zorgvuldig en neemt verantwoordelijkheid; Je communiceert duidelijk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar (stageduur ± 4 maanden). Waarom stage lopen bij Quatra? Een meewerkstage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het team; Veel verantwoordelijkheid en hands-on ervaring binnen een snelgroeiende en duurzame organisatie. Een informele, directe en betrokken werksfeer waarin jouw ideeën welkom zijn. Goede stagevergoeding en de kans om echt impact te maken. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the role 0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers. Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes: Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes Kubernetes clusters and managed databases A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs. What you'll own You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill. Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses. Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity. Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades. Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap. Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps. Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're always looking for thoughtful, driven Engineering Managers to add to our org. Some of our teams are building customer-facing product and workflows; others keep our distributed systems reliable, observable, and ready to scale. Whichever kind of problem energizes you, if you lead people well, hold a high technical bar, and drive work to completion without waiting to be handed a plan, we want to hear from you. About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data—what people do or don't do inside a web or mobile app. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence. What we value Ownership. You set direction and see initiatives through. You create clarity when things are murky and set the path forward rather than waiting for one to be defined, and you're motivated by impact—not just intention. You hold yourself and your team accountable to shipping, not just staying busy. Leaders who can do both. You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align stakeholders on a plan and earn your engineers' respect in the same day—you don't choose between vision and execution, you hold both. A drive to execute through resistance. Competing priorities, skeptical stakeholders, tired teams—you've moved work forward anyway. You name the resistance, make the call, and own the milestones and the misses. An AI-first mindset. AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You have a real, concrete point of view on AI-native development, you use agentic tooling yourself, and you bring it into how your squad operates. A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done." Y

jobs.description: About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role We're looking for a Head of Security to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself. Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), with React front ends, organized into autonomous product teams. Security here works as an enabler embedded in how teams ship, not a gate at the end. AI-assisted development is core to how we build, so you'll be expected to use AI tooling fluently for security work, and to define how we adopt AI agents and LLM-powered systems safely. jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - France
jobs.description: Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.  We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It s the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.    Verkada is currently searching for a talented and ambitious sales representative to grow out our Enterprise function from the ground in France. You would be directly responsible for a greenfield territory with a virtually untapped market of enterprise customers.    Verkada is building a world-class sales organization. Our business requires highly motivated and capable sales professionals. We prioritize drive and demonstrated success in whatever sales role you’ve been in before — we care far less about fancy pedigrees, schools, or a resume with “brand name” companies. jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management,

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director, Financial Services
jobs.description: About us At Sierra , we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. About the Financial Services team Our financial services customers span systemically important banks, neobanks committed to building more delightful banking software (1 in 3 of the world's leading banks use Sierra!), insurers that provide protection for life’s most challenging moments, vertically integrated ecosystems like Rocket Companies, and more. The decisions we make impact millions of end customers and billions of dollars in economic activity. Our financial services team partners closely with these organizations to set their AI strategies and build modern tools that carefully handle moments when a person’s private anxiety meets an institution’s procedural muscle - the instant before a family learns whether they are pre-approved for a mortgage; the claustrophobic half hour after someone notices a fraudulent charge;

Partner for Growth: Develop relationships with local MSSPs, VARs, and other strategic partners to expand market reach and bring solutions to more organizations. Stay Informed: Stay ahead of industry trends and help position our solutions

jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description: About Wallee Group AG Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers. The Role The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy. In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products. The Impact You’ll Make Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Ensure flawless execution of service delivery, safety standards, and overall club ambiance. Manage bookings, attendance, and class feedback to continually refine offerings. Lead production of special community classes, themed experiences, and seasonal wellness events. 3. Operational Excellence & Brand Standards Maintain a pristine, spa-like environment that meets luxury wellness standards. Ensure all brand touchpoints—from service flow to visual merchandising—reflect the studio identity. Oversee inventory, equipment needs, and facility upkeep in coordination with the operations team.

jobs.title: Real Estate Business Developer
jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. Maintain and oversee the organization of financial records and supporting documentation, ensuring proper documentation, accessibility, retention, and compliance with established records management and audit requirements. Perform quarterly balance sheet account reconciliation activities across assigned entities, including analysis of account movements, identification of aged or unusual items, investigation of variances, and timely resolution or escalation of reconciling items. Perform end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting activities for assigned entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions and appropriate recognition of costs in accordance with accounting policies. Monitor and manage the vendor invoice lifecycle, including follow-up on outstanding invoices, resolution of invoice-related issues, coordination with vendors and internal stakeholders, and timely processing to support accurate period-end closing and payment. Prepare and process customer billing and invoices, ensuring appropriate supporting documentation, accurate accounting information, adherence to contractual requirements, and compliance with internal controls and billing procedures.
